note: A set selected for the curator's research field. The papers are the work of their own authors; the curator selected them and is not their author.
method: Seminal and highly cited journal articles on the field's core topics, resolved in OpenAlex by title, kept only when the journal is Q1 in the owner's SCImago bank, DOI verified in Crossref, no retraction notice.
